arms.description: A battle-hardened master of weapons, using mobility and overpowering attacks to strike their opponents down. Preferred Weapon: Two-Handed Axe, Mace, Sword

left.name: Slayer
left.description: A vicious Warrior who sets their sights on a target and pursues it relentlessly, overwhelming their foes with an onslaught of steel and might.

right.name: Colossus
right.description: A veteran of countless battles who can shrug off attacks that would fell others while using their expertise to deliver their most powerful strikes and destroy their enemies.

nodes.name: Battle Stance
nodes.description:
A balanced combat state that increases the critical strike chance of your abilities by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects by 10%. 

Lasts until canceled.

nodes.name: Defensive Stance
nodes.description:
A defensive combat state that reduces all damage you take by 15% and all damage you deal by 10%.

Lasts until canceled.

nodes.name: Fast Footwork
nodes.description: Movement speed increased by 5%.

nodes.name: War Machine
nodes.description:
Your auto-attacks generate 10% more Rage.

Killing an enemy instantly generates 5 Rage and increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 sec.

nodes.name: Thunder Clap
nodes.description: Blasts all enemies within 8 yards for 83 Physical damage and reduces their movement speed by 20% for 10 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

nodes.name: Leeching Strikes
nodes.description: Leech increased by 3%.

nodes.name: Impending Victory
nodes.description:
Instantly attack the target, causing 20 damage and healing you for 30% of your maximum health.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor resets the cooldown of Impending Victory and makes it cost no Rage.

nodes.name: Heroic Leap
nodes.description: Leap through the air toward a target location, slamming down with destructive force to deal 8 Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yards.

nodes.name: Crackling Thunder
nodes.description: Thunder Clap's radius is increased by 50% and it reduces affected target's movement speed by an additional 20%.

nodes.name: Storm Bolt
nodes.description: Hurls your weapon at an enemy, causing 10 Physical damage and stunning for 4 sec.

nodes.name: Rend
nodes.description: Wounds the target, causing 44 Physical damage instantly and an additional 74 Bleed damage over 15 sec.

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.description:
Restores 6% health every 1 sec when you have not taken damage for 5 sec.

Restores 2% health every 1 sec while you are below 35% health. The amount restored increases the closer you are to death.

nodes.name: Frothing Berserker
nodes.description: Mortal Strike and Cleave have a 20% chance to immediately refund 10% of the Rage spent.

nodes.name: Bounding Stride
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Heroic Leap by 15 sec and Heroic Leap also increases your movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.

nodes.name: Pain and Gain
nodes.description:
When you take any damage, heal for 2.0% of your maximum health. 

This can only occur once every 10 sec.

choices.name: Intervene
choices.description: Run at high speed toward an ally, intercepting all melee and ranged attacks against them for 6 sec while they remain within 10 yds.

choices.name: Interpose
choices.description: Run at high speed toward a target location near your allies, taking 30% of all damage dealt to allies within 3 yards for 8 sec or until you take at least 6,110 damage from this effect.

nodes.name: Shockwave
nodes.description: Sends a wave of force in a frontal cone, causing 6 damage and stunning all enemies within 10 yards for 2 sec.

nodes.name: Overwhelming Rage
nodes.description: Maximum Rage increased by 30.

nodes.name: Rallying Cry
nodes.description:
Lets loose a rallying cry, granting all party or raid members within 40 yards 10% temporary and maximum health for 10 sec.

Health granted increased by 50% when not in a raid.

nodes.name: Field Dressing
nodes.description: Healing received increased by 3% and all self-healing increased by an additional 10%.

nodes.name: Spell Reflection
nodes.description: Raise your weapon, reflecting the first spell cast on you and reducing magic damage you take by 20% for 5 sec.

choices.name: Wrecking Throw
choices.description: Hurl your weapon at the enemy, causing 208 Physical damage, ignoring armor. Deals up to 500% increased damage to absorb shields.

choices.name: Shattering Throw
choices.description: Hurl your weapon at the enemy,  removing any magical immunities and causing 211 Physical damage, ignoring armor. Deals up to 500% increased damage to absorb shields.

nodes.name: Rumbling Earth
nodes.description: Shockwave's range increased by 6 yards and when it strikes at least 3 targets its cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.

choices.name: Berserker Shout
choices.description:
Go berserk, removing and granting immunity to Fear, Sap, and Incapacitate effects for 6 sec.

Also remove fear effects from group members within 12 yds.

choices.name: Fearless
choices.description: Cooldown of Berserker Rage is reduced by 50% and Berseker Rage removes all movement speed-impairing effects.

choices.name: Intimidating Shout
choices.description:
Causes the targeted enemy to cower in fear while all enemies within 8 yards flee from you and their movement speed is reduced by 70% for 8 sec.
Damage may cancel the effect.

choices.name: Piercing Howl
choices.description:
Snares all enemies within 12 yards, reducing their movement speed by 70% for 8 sec.

Spurs all allies within 6 yards, increasing their movement speed by 30% for 4 sec.

nodes.name: Honed Reflexes
nodes.description:
Cooldown of Die By the Sword, Intervene, Interpose, Spell Reflection, Storm Bolt, and Pummel reduced by 10%.

Successfully interrupting an enemy increases the damage you deal to them by 5% for 10 sec.

nodes.name: Armored to the Teeth
nodes.description: Gain Strength equal to 5% of your Armor.

nodes.name: Double Time
nodes.description: Charge gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 3 sec.

nodes.name: Reinforced Plates
nodes.description: Stamina increased by 5% and Armor increased by 5%.

nodes.name: Barbaric Training
nodes.description: Slam, Whirlwind, and Cleave deal 10% more damage and 5% increased critical strike damage.

nodes.name: Javelineer
nodes.description:
Range of your thrown abilities is increased by 5 yards.

Damage dealt by Champion's Spear, Shattering Throw, and Wrecking Throw increased by 20%.

Shattering Throw and Wrecking Throw silence non-players for 3 sec.

nodes.name: Resonant Voice
nodes.description: The effects of your shouts last 20% longer.

nodes.name: Crushing Force
nodes.description: Mortal Strike deals an additional 5% damage and deals 5% increased critical strike damage.

nodes.name: Cruel Strikes
nodes.description: Critical strike chance increased by 1% and critical strike damage of Execute increased by 5%.

nodes.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
nodes.description: While wielding two-handed weapons your damage is increased by 3% and damage taken from area of effect attacks is reduced by 2%.

nodes.name: Wild Strikes
nodes.description: Haste increased by 1% and your auto-attack critical strikes increase your auto-attack speed by 10% for 10 sec.

nodes.name: Anger Management
nodes.description: Every 20 Rage you spend on attacks reduces the remaining cooldown on Avatar and Colossus Smash by 1 sec.

nodes.name: Champion's Spear
nodes.description:
Throw a spear at the target location, chaining all enemies in the area to the spear's location and dealing 83 Physical damage instantly and an additional 128 Physical damage over 6 sec. 

While the spear is active, activating this ability will cause you to leap to the spear, dealing 16 Physical damage to all targets.

All damage dealt reduced beyond 5 targets.

Generates 10 Rage.

nodes.name: Stance Mastery
nodes.description:
Your stances have additional effects.

 Battle Stance
Increases the critical strike damage of your abilities by 3%.

 Defensive Stance
When an attack deals 20% or more of your maximum health in damage, that damage is reduced by 15%.

nodes.name: Battlefield Commander
nodes.description:
Your Shout abilities have additional effects.

 Battle Shout:
Grants you an additional 3% attack power.

 Rallying Cry:
Grants an additional 2% health and duration increased by 3 sec.

 Piercing Howl:
Radius increased by 100%

 Berserker Shout:
Radius increased by 100%.

 Intimidating Shout:
Cooldown reduced by 15 sec.

nodes.name: Mortal Strike
nodes.description: A vicious strike that deals 179 Physical damage and reduces the effectiveness of healing on the target by 50% for 10 sec.

nodes.name: Overpower
nodes.description: Overpower the enemy, dealing 134 Physical damage. Cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

nodes.name: Sudden Death
nodes.description: Your attacks have a chance to make your next Execute cost no Rage, be usable on any target regardless of their health, and deal damage as if you spent 40 Rage.

choices.name: Fueled by Violence
choices.description: You are healed for 85% of the Bleed damage dealt by Rend and Deep Wounds.

choices.name: Ignore Pain
choices.description: Fight through the pain, ignoring 50% of damage taken for 12 sec or until 700 damage has been prevented.

nodes.name: Die by the Sword
nodes.description: Increases your parry chance by 100% and reduces all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.

nodes.name: Bloodsurge
nodes.description: Damage from Rend has a chance to generate 5 Rage.

nodes.name: Improved Overpower
nodes.description: Overpower has 2 charges and deals 15% more damage.

nodes.name: Improved Execute
nodes.description: Execute no longer has a cooldown and if your foe survives, 10% of the Rage spent is refunded.

nodes.name: Fervor of Battle
nodes.description: If Cleave or Whirlwind hits 3 or more targets you also Slam your primary target. This Slam deals 50% additional damage.

nodes.name: Tactician
nodes.description:
You have a 30% chance to gain a charge of Overpower when you use an attack that has a Rage cost.
This effect applies even if that ability's Rage cost has been reduced to zero.

nodes.name: Colossus Smash
nodes.description: Smash the ground and shatter the armor of all enemies within 10 yds, dealing 104 Physical damage and increasing damage you deal to them by 30% for 10 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

nodes.name: Impale
nodes.description: Critical strike damage of your abilities is increased by 10%.

choices.name: Brute Force
choices.description: Slam has a 10% increased chance to trigger Tactician.

choices.name: Efficiency
choices.description: Slam's Rage cost is reduced by 25%.

choices.name: Overpowering Finish
choices.description: Overpower deals 15% additional damage to targets below 35% health.

choices.name: Mass Execution
choices.description: Cleave and Whirlwind deal 20% additional damage to targets below 35% health.

nodes.name: Strength of Arms
nodes.description:
Overpower and Slam damage increased by 5% and critical strike damage increased by 5%.
Critical strike chance of Slam and Overpower increased by 5%.

choices.name: Just Warming Up
choices.description: Colossus Smash generates 15 Rage.

choices.name: Broad Strokes
choices.description: Colossus Smash grants 6 stacks of Sweeping Strikes.

nodes.name: Sharpened Blades
nodes.description: Mortal Strike, Cleave, and Execute damage increased by 7% and critical strike damage increased by 7%.

nodes.name: Cleave
nodes.description:
Strikes all enemies in front of you for 82 Physical damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

If you know Rend, inflicts Rend on all targets.

nodes.name: Powerful Momentum
nodes.description: Secondary targets take an additional 20% damage from Sweeping Strikes.

nodes.name: Martial Prowess
nodes.description: Overpower and Slam increase the damage of your next Mortal Strike by 5%, stacking up to 3 times.

nodes.name: Dreadnaught
nodes.description:
Overpower's impact causes a seismic wave, dealing 48 damage to all enemies in a 10 yd line around your target. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

Dreadnaught benefits from all effects that modify Overpower's damage.

nodes.name: Deep Wounds
nodes.description:
Execute inflicts Deep Wounds on the target.

 Deep Wounds
Causes the target to suffer 50 Bleed damage over 6 sec. If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Deep Wounds.

choices.name: Tactical Edge
choices.description: Colossus Smash immediately grants 1 use of Sudden Death.

choices.name: Crushing Combo
choices.description: Colossus Smash causes your next 2 Cleaves within 20 sec to trigger no cooldown.

nodes.name: Massacre
nodes.description: Execute is usable on targets below 35% health.

nodes.name: Collateral Damage
nodes.description: When an ability used during Sweeping Strikes damages a second target, your next Cleave or Whirlwind deals 25% increased damage, stacking up to 3 times.

nodes.name: Bloodborne
nodes.description: Your Bleed effects deal 5% increased damage and 5% increased critical strike damage.

choices.name: Bladestorm
choices.description:
Become an unstoppable storm of destructive force, striking all nearby enemies for 657 Physical damage over 5.4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

You are immune to movement impairing and loss of control effects, but can use defensive abilities and can avoid attacks.

choices.name: Ravager
choices.description:
Throws a whirling weapon at your target that chases nearby enemies, inflicting 371 Physical damage to all enemies over 12 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

Enemies damaged by Ravager take 50% additional damage from your Bleeds for 12 sec.

nodes.name: Critical Thinking
nodes.description: Execute critical strike chance increased by 5% and Execute immediately refunds an additional 10% of the Rage spent.

nodes.name: Master Tactician
nodes.description: Tactician has a 5% increased chance to trigger.

nodes.name: Bloodletting
nodes.description:
Your abilities have a 5% increased chance to critically strike targets affected by Rend.

If you know Rend, Mortal Strike inflicts Rend on targets below 35% health.

Deep Wounds lasts 33% longer.

nodes.name: Executioner's Precision
nodes.description: Execute increases the damage of your next Mortal Strike by 35%, stacking up to 2 times.

nodes.name: Fatality
nodes.description: Mortal Strike has a 50% chance to apply a Fatal Mark to your target, stacking up to 5 times. Your next Execute on a target with a Fatal Mark causes the Fatal Mark to deal 96 additional Physical damage per stack.

nodes.name: Battlelord
nodes.description: Overpower has a 35% chance to reset the cooldown of Mortal Strike and reduce the cost of your next Mortal Strike by 33%.

nodes.name: Mortal Wounds
nodes.description:
Mortal Strike and Slam critical strikes inflict Deep Wounds at 100% effectiveness.

 Deep Wounds
Causes the target to suffer 50 Bleed damage over 6 sec. If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Deep Wounds.

nodes.name: Avatar
nodes.description: Transform into a colossus, increasing all damage you deal by 20% and reducing damage you take from area of effect attacks by 5% for 20 sec.

ranks.description:
Your single target melee abilities have a chance to upgrade Slam to Heroic Strike.
All modifiers and talents that affect Slam also affect Heroic Strike.
Each stack of Master of Warfare increases Mortal Strike, Cleave, and Overpower damage by 2.5% and critical strike damage by 2.5%.
Heroic Strike increases the damage you deal to enemies affected by your next Colossus Smash by an additional 3.0%. Stacks up to 5 times.

nodes.name: Show No Mercy
nodes.description: Executioner also increases your Execute critical strike chance and critical strike damage by 3% per stack.

choices.name: Culling Cyclone
choices.description: Each strike of Bladestorm deals an additional 20% damage evenly split across all targets.

choices.name: Brutal Finish
choices.description: Your next Mortal Strike after Bladestorm ends deals 50% additional damage.

choices.name: Fierce Followthrough
choices.description: Mortal Strike critical strikes increase the damage of your next Mortal Strike by 20%.

choices.name: Opportunist
choices.description: When Overpower has its cooldown reset by Tactician, your next Overpower deals 20% additional damage and 20% additional critical damage. Stacking up to 2 times.

nodes.name: Imminent Demise
nodes.description:
Every 3 Slayer's Strikes you gain Sudden Death.

Using Sudden Death accelerates your next Bladestorm, striking 1 additional time (max 3). Bladestorm's total duration is unchanged.

Sudden Death has a 100% chance to trigger Reap the Storm at 100% effectiveness.

choices.name: Relentless Pursuit
choices.description:
Charge increases your movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.

Charge removes all movement impairing effects, this effect cannot occur more than once every 30 sec.

choices.name: Vicious Agility
choices.description: Heroic Leap reduces the cooldown of Charge by 5 sec and Charge reduces the cooldown of Heroic Leap by 2 sec.

nodes.name: Slayer's Malice
nodes.description: Overpower and Execute damage increased by 15%.

nodes.name: Reap the Storm
nodes.description: When Cleave hits 3 or more targets you have a 20% chance to unleash a flurry of steel, striking all nearby enemies for 267 Physical damage and applying Overwhelmed. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

nodes.name: Overwhelming Blades
nodes.description: Each strike of Bladestorm applies Overwhelmed to all enemies affected, increasing damage you deal to them by 1% for 20 sec, max 5 stacks.

nodes.name: Death Drive
nodes.description: You heal for 15% of damage dealt by Sudden Death.

nodes.name: Slayer's Dominance
nodes.description: Your attacks against your primary target have a 25% chance to overwhelm their defenses and trigger a Slayer's Strike, dealing 294 Physical damage and granting you a stack of Executioner, increasing your Execute damage by 3% for 12 sec. Multiple stacks of Executioner may overlap.

nodes.name: Unrelenting Onslaught
nodes.description:
Using Sudden Death causes you to both reduce the cooldown of Bladestorm by 5 sec and apply 1 stack of Overwhelmed to your primary target per stack of Executioner you have.

You can use Pummel and Storm Bolt while Bladestorming.

Bladestorm damage increased by 20%.

nodes.name: Unhinged
nodes.description: Every 2 strikes of Bladestorm, you automatically cast a Mortal Strike at your target or random nearby enemy, dealing 100% of normal damage.

nodes.name: Deadly Focus
nodes.description: Executioner's duration is increased by 6 sec.

nodes.name: Violent Euphoria
nodes.description: Bladestorm puts you into a battle trance, granting you 15% haste for 8 sec after you stop Bladestorming.

choices.name: Boneshaker
choices.description: Shockwave's stun duration is increased by 1 sec and reduces the movement speed of affected enemies by 40% for 3 sec after the stun ends.

choices.name: Earthquaker
choices.description: Shockwave also knocks enemies into the air and its cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.

nodes.name: Dominance of the Colossus
nodes.description:
Enemies affected by Demolish take up to 10% more damage from you and deal up to 20% less damage to you for 10 sec based on the number of stacks of Colossal Might consumed by Demolish.

Colossal Might stacks up to 10 times.

nodes.name: Precise Might
nodes.description: Mortal Strike critical strikes grant an additional stack of Colossal Might.

nodes.name: Practiced Strikes
nodes.description:
Mortal Strike and Slam damage increased by 25%.

Cleave and Whirlwind damage increased by 15%.

choices.name: One Against Many
choices.description: Shockwave, Cleave, and Whirlwind deal 5% more damage per target affected up to 5.

choices.name: Arterial Bleed
choices.description: Colossal Might increases the damage of your Rend and Deep Wounds by 3% per stack.

nodes.name: Mountain of Muscle and Scars
nodes.description:
You deal 5% more damage and take 5% less damage.

Size increased by 5%.

nodes.name: Tide of Battle
nodes.description: Colossal Might increases the damage of your Overpower and Execute by 3% per stack.

nodes.name: Martial Expert
nodes.description: Critical strike damage of your abilities is increased by 10% and the amount of damage blocked by your critical blocks is increased by 20%.

choices.name: No Stranger to Pain
choices.description: Damage prevented by each use of Ignore Pain is increased by 30%.

choices.name: Veteran Vitality
choices.description:
When your health is brought below 35%, you gain a Second Wind, healing you for 12% of your max health over 2 sec.

This effect cannot occur more than once every 60 sec.

nodes.name: Demolish
nodes.description:
Unleash a series of precise and powerful strikes against your target, dealing 791 damage to it, and 429 damage to enemies within 10 yds of it. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

While channeling Demolish, you take 10% less damage and are immune to stuns, knockbacks, and forced movement effects.

You can block, parry, dodge, and use certain defensive abilities while channeling Demolish.

nodes.name: Colossal Might
nodes.description:
Colossal Might increases damage dealt by your next Demolish by 5%, stacking up to 5 times.

Mortal Strike grants a stack of Colossal Might and Cleave grants a stack of Colossal Might when it strikes 3 or more targets.

nodes.name: Celeritous Conclusion
nodes.description: Demolish's final strike grants 10% Haste for 10 sec and increases the critical strike chance of your next Mortal Strike by 100%.

nodes.name: Cut to the Bone
nodes.description: Mortal Strike critical strikes increase your Rend and Deep Wounds damage by 15% for 8 sec.

nodes.name: Decimator
nodes.description: Demolish's final strike applies Deep Wounds to all targets at 100% effectiveness.

fury.description: A furious dual-wielding berserker unleashing a flurry of attacks to carve their opponents to pieces. Preferred Weapons: Dual Two-Handed Axes, Maces, Swords

left.name: Slayer
left.description: A vicious Warrior who sets their sights on a target and pursues it relentlessly, overwhelming their foes with an onslaught of steel and might.

right.name: Mountain Thane
right.description: Mountain Thanes are fierce fighters that live to challenge themselves against worthy opponents. Drawing strength from the earth and power from the storm, they strike with blows that hit like a thunder clap to overwhelm their enemies.

Assault the target in a bloodthirsty craze, dealing 149 Physical damage and restoring 3% of your health.

Generates 8 Rage and has a 30% chance to Enrage you.

nodes.description:

nodes.name: Ground Current
nodes.description: Lightning Strikes also deal 39 Nature damage to enemies near their target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

nodes.name: Lightning Strikes
nodes.description:
Damaging enemies with Thunder Clap, Raging Blow, or Execute has a 25% chance to also strike one with a lightning bolt, dealing 55 Nature damage.

Lightning Strikes occur 30% more often during Avatar.

nodes.name: Avatar of the Storm
nodes.description:
Casting Avatar grants you 2 charges of Thunder Blast and resets the cooldown of Thunder Clap.

While Avatar is not active, Lightning Strikes have a 10% chance to grant you Avatar for 4 secs.

Thunder Blast
Your next Thunder Clap becomes a Thunder Blast that deals Stormstrike damage.

nodes.name: Burst of Power
nodes.description: Lightning Strikes have a 15% chance to make your next 2 Bloodthirsts have no cooldown.

nodes.name: Strength of the Mountain
nodes.description:
Shield Slam damage increased by 15%.

Bloodthirst and Rampage damage increased by 25%.

nodes.name: Crashing Thunder
nodes.description:
Stormstrike or Nature damage your abilities deal is increased by 5%. Stormstrike damage ignores Armor.

Thunder Clap damage increased by 10%.

choices.name: Storm Bolts
choices.description: Storm Bolt also hits 2 additional nearby targets, stunning them for 2 sec, but its cooldown is increased by 10 sec.

choices.name: Storm Shield
choices.description: Intervening a target grants them a shield for 5 sec that absorbs magic damage equal to 3 times your Armor.

nodes.name: Capacitance
nodes.description: During Avatar, Thunder Blast extends Avatar's duration by 2.0 sec.

nodes.name: Conductivity
nodes.description: Lightning Strike damage increased by 10% and critical strike damage increased by 10%.

nodes.name: Storm Surge
nodes.description: Avatar increases the damage of Thunder Clap by 50% and reduces its cooldown by 50%.

choices.name: Boneshaker
choices.description: Shockwave's stun duration is increased by 1 sec and reduces the movement speed of affected enemies by 40% for 3 sec after the stun ends.

choices.name: Earthquaker
choices.description: Shockwave also knocks enemies into the air and its cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.

nodes.name: Dominance of the Colossus
nodes.description:
Enemies affected by Demolish take up to 10% more damage from you and deal up to 20% less damage to you for 10 sec based on the number of stacks of Colossal Might consumed by Demolish.

Colossal Might stacks up to 10 times.

nodes.name: Precise Might
nodes.description: Mortal Strike critical strikes grant an additional stack of Colossal Might.

nodes.name: Practiced Strikes
nodes.description:
Mortal Strike and Slam damage increased by 25%.

Cleave and Whirlwind damage increased by 15%.

choices.name: One Against Many
choices.description: Shockwave, Cleave, and Whirlwind deal 5% more damage per target affected up to 5.

choices.name: Arterial Bleed
choices.description: Colossal Might increases the damage of your Rend and Deep Wounds by 3% per stack.

nodes.name: Mountain of Muscle and Scars
nodes.description:
You deal 5% more damage and take 5% less damage.

Size increased by 5%.

nodes.name: Tide of Battle
nodes.description: Colossal Might increases the damage of your Overpower and Execute by 3% per stack.

nodes.name: Martial Expert
nodes.description: Critical strike damage of your abilities is increased by 10% and the amount of damage blocked by your critical blocks is increased by 20%.

choices.name: No Stranger to Pain
choices.description: Damage prevented by each use of Ignore Pain is increased by 30%.

choices.name: Veteran Vitality
choices.description:
When your health is brought below 35%, you gain a Second Wind, healing you for 12% of your max health over 2 sec.

This effect cannot occur more than once every 60 sec.

nodes.name: Demolish
nodes.description:
Unleash a series of precise and powerful strikes against your target, dealing 794 damage to it, and 429 damage to enemies within 10 yds of it. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

While channeling Demolish, you take 10% less damage and are immune to stuns, knockbacks, and forced movement effects.

You can block, parry, dodge, and use certain defensive abilities while channeling Demolish.

nodes.name: Colossal Might
nodes.description:
Colossal Might increases damage dealt by your next Demolish by 5%, stacking up to 5 times.

Mortal Strike grants a stack of Colossal Might and Cleave grants a stack of Colossal Might when it strikes 3 or more targets.

nodes.name: Celeritous Conclusion
nodes.description: Demolish's final strike grants 10% Haste for 10 sec and increases the critical strike chance of your next Mortal Strike by 100%.

nodes.name: Cut to the Bone
nodes.description: Mortal Strike critical strikes increase your Rend and Deep Wounds damage by 15% for 8 sec.

nodes.name: Decimator
nodes.description: Demolish's final strike applies Deep Wounds to all targets at 100% effectiveness.
